# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned Bucket, RDS, IAM Role

## Directory Layout

```
crossplane/
├── xrd.yaml
├── composition-pipeline.yaml
├── providerconfig-dev.yaml
├── providerconfig-prod.yaml
└── examples/
    ├── dev-xr.yaml
    └── prod-xr.yaml
```

**Crossplane version:** 1.17+, using **Composition Functions pipeline mode** with `function-patch-and-transform` (v0.8+). Provider: `provider-aws` (`upbound/provider-aws` family).

---

## 1. XRD — `xrd.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xplatformbuckets.platform.example.io
spec:
  group: platform.example.io
  names:
    kind: XPlatformBucket
    plural: xplatformbuckets
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required: [region, environment]
              properties:
                region:
                  type: string
                  description: Primary AWS region.
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum: [dev, prod]
                  description: Environment selector; drives sizing and features.
                replicationRegion:
                  type: string
                  description: Target region for cross-region replication (prod only).
                database:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    instanceClass:
                      type: string
                      default: db.t3.micro
                    multiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    backupRetentionDays:
                      type: integer
                      default: 7
                        minimum: 7
                    allocatedStorageGB:
                      type: integer
                      default: 20
                iam:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    rolePolicyDocument:
                      type: string
                      description: JSON policy document for the service account role.
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketName:
                  type: string
                dbEndpoint:
                  type: string
                iamRoleArn:
                  type: string
                connectionSecretName:
                  type: string
```

---

## 2. Composition — `composition-pipeline.yaml`

Uses the functions pipeline with `function-patch-and-transform`. All env-differentiation is done via patch-and-transform `EnvironmentPatches`/conditional patches keyed on `spec.environment` and `spec.region`, so **one Composition serves dev and prod** — environment isolation comes from each cluster/ProviderConfig (`provider-aws-<env>`), per Crossplane idiom.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xplatformbuckets.aws.platform.example.io
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XPlatformBucket
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:

          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          # 1. S3 Bucket with versioning + encryption + public access block
          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: app-assets-bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Bucket
              metadata:
                annotations:
                  crossplane.io/external-name: ""   # derived via name patch below
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                    - rule:
                        applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                          # For prod we override to aws:kms below
                        bucketKeyEnabled: true
                deletionPolicy: Orphan  # buckets are precious; pilot-delete on non-prod
              providerConfigRef:
                name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                toFieldPath: status.bucketName
              # Prod: use KMS CMK instead of AES256
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.serverSideEncryptionConfiguration[0].rule.applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault[0].sseAlgorithm
                transforms:
                  - map:
                      prod: aws:kms
                      dev: AES256
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Required

          # Bucket versioning (both envs required by spec)
          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
              providerConfigRef:
                name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
                transforms:
                  - string:
                      fmt: "%s-app-assets-bucket"

          # Block all public access (acceptance criterion)
          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
              providerConfigRef:
                name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
                transforms:
                  - string:
                      fmt: "%s-app-assets-bucket"

          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          # 2. RDS PostgreSQL — deletion protection, backups >= 7d, private
          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: rds-postgres
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "15"
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  multiAz: false
                  publiclyAccessible: false        # always private
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  deletionProtection: true          # acceptance criterion
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  usernameSecretRef:
                    key: password
                    name: db-master-secret
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  namespace: crossplane-system
                  name: db-conn-secret
              providerConfigRef:
                name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.instanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.backupRetentionDays
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.allocatedStorageGB
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - string:
                      fmt: "xr-db-conn-%s"
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                toFieldPath: status.connectionSecretName

          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          # 3. IAM Role for service accounts (least privilege, no wildcards in prod)
          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: iam-service-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [{
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Principal": { "Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com" },
                        "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                      }]
                    }
              providerConfigRef:
                name: default
            patches:
              # Prod: swap trust policy to EKS OIDC (scoped to cluster issuer), narrow actions
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                transforms:
                  - map:
                      prod: |
                        {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [{
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::<account-id>:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.<region>.amazonaws.com" },
                            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                            "Condition": { "StringEquals": {
                              "oidc.eks.<region>.amazonaws.com:sub": "system:serviceaccount:<ns>:app-sa" } }
                          }]
                        }
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # Least-privilege inline policy — bucket-scoped; prod forbids wildcards via same scoping
          - name: iam-service-role-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  policy: "{}"
              providerConfigRef:
                name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
                    - fromFieldPath: status.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                transforms:
                  - string:
                      type: fmt
                      fmt: |
                        {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                            {
                              "Sid": "BucketList",
                              "Effect": "Allow",
                              "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
                              "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::%s", "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"]
                            }
                          ]
                        }
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.iamRoleArn
```

> If your `function-patch-and-transform` version supports **TransformResources**/`map` shorthand (v0.5+ uses `- map:` transforms shown above); otherwise express the same as `string.transform: map`.

---

## 3. Claim / XR Examples

### `examples/dev-xr.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: PlatformBucket
metadata:
  name: app-assets-dev
spec:
  compositionRef:
    name: xplatformbuckets.aws.platform.example.io
  region: us-east-1
  environment: dev
  database:
    instanceClass: db.t3.micro
    multiAZ: false
    backupRetentionDays: 7
```

### `examples/prod-xr.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: PlatformBucket
metadata:
  name: app-assets-prod
spec:
  compositionRef:
    name: xplatformbuckets.aws.platform.example.io
  region: eu-central-1
  environment: prod
  replicationRegion: us-west-2   # CRR target (requires BucketReplicationConfig MR)
  database:
    instanceClass: db.t3.medium
    multiAZ: true
    backupRetentionDays: 14
```

---

## 4. ProviderConfigs (environment separation)

Per Crossplane idiom, **dev and prod are separate control planes (or namespaces) with separate `ProviderConfig`s**:

```yaml
# providerconfig-dev.yaml
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: default          # on the dev cluster's Crossplane
spec:
  credentials:
    source: IRSA         # OIDC-derived, never stored keys in Git (criterion 3)
```

Apply the same manifest to the prod cluster independently — clusters are isolated, so changing prod XR state cannot affect dev (criterion 7).

---

## Notes & Compliance Mapping

| Criterion | Implementation |
|---|---|
| 1 | `BucketVersioning` Enabled, SSE config, `BucketPublicAccessBlock` all true |
| 2 | `deletionProtection: true`, `publiclyAccessible: false`, retention ≥ 7 enforced via XRD schema `minimum` |
| 3 | IRSA credential source; DB creds via Kubernetes Secrets refs |
| 4 | IAM policy scoped to exact bucket ARNs, explicit actions only |
| 6/5/HTTPS cluster, ALB/CloudFront | Out of this task's three resources; included in the wider scenario spec but not this deliverable |

For **cross-region replication** (prod-only), add a managed `s3.aws.upbound.io/BucketReplicationConfig` resource gated by an additional function (e.g., `function-go-templating` with an `if eq .observed.composite.resource.spec.environment "prod"` guard) — pure patch-and-transform can't conditionally include whole resources, which is a known limitation of this mode.
